description: Purchase of vehicles required for the island-wide Range Offices and Beat Offices under the Department of Wildlife Conservation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2025-08-18 for the purchase of vehicles required for the island-wide Range Offices and Beat Offices of the Department of Wildlife Conservation to be used for wild elephant management duties and other field duties. Accordingly, bids have been invited for the purchase of 16 double cabs, 84 single cabs and 09 four-wheel tractors under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the bids received for the same, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to purchase the said vehicles from the substantially responsive lowest bidders, as follows:
